recognize_zh: 嗜中性球核呈兩個圓形葉以細絲相連的「夾鼻眼鏡」（pince-nez）狀，染色質粗塊狀，而細胞質顆粒正常；骨髓中大多數成熟嗜中性球同樣呈雙葉或不分葉，且無其他造血異常，符合良性遺傳性 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus: two round, dense lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand (pince-nez/spectacle form) (A)
Normal volume of pale cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granulation (no hypogranularity)
Bone marrow aspirate (B): most band and segmented-stage neutrophils are bilobed or peanut-shaped with clumped chromatin; orderly maturation of myelocytes and metamyelocytes and an eosinophil present
No blast increase or dyserythropoiesis evident in the field; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with bilobed, spectacle-shaped nuclei composed of two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin filament, with coarsely clumped chromatin and normally granulated cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate demonstrates orderly granulocytic maturation in which the majority of mature neutrophils are bilobed or non-lobed with similar chromatin condensation, without hypogranulation, increased blasts or other dysplasia in the field. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly; the uniform involvement of neutrophils and absence of dysplasia favor the benign inherited (LBR-related) form, which can be confirmed by family studies.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Pelger cells involve only a subset of neutrophils and are accompanied by hypogranulation, cytopenias, dysplasia in other lineages or a clonal abnormality.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., tacrolimus, mycophenolate, taxanes)
ddx.vs: Drug-related hyposegmentation appears after exposure and resolves on withdrawal, whereas the inherited anomaly is lifelong and familial.
Band neutrophils have a C-shaped nonconstricted nucleus with less clumped chromatin and coexist with toxic changes in infection.
Homozygotes show predominantly round, non-lobed (Stodgy) nuclei in nearly all neutrophils rather than the bilobed pince-nez forms of heterozygotes.

captions: Peripheral blood: bilobed pince-nez neutrophil with clumped chromatin
Bone marrow aspirate: many hyposegmented mature neutrophils with normal maturation
